summary:
ATHERIA is an AI-powered environmental intelligence platform designed to help users investigate changes in Earth's systems and understand emerging environmental threats. By selecting a location on an interactive 3D Earth, users can explore environmental conditions across five key domains: drought, wildfires, extreme heat, flooding, and marine pollution.

The platform integrates NASA Earth science data, including NASA POWER observations, to analyze environmental patterns and historical trends. Its AI-driven workflow aims to connect multiple environmental indicators, interpret available observations, and provide accessible insights and preparedness recommendations.

ATHERIA also explores how current conditions and available forecast products can help identify potential future environmental risks. By transforming complex scientific information into understandable visualizations and reports, the project aims to make Earth observation data more accessible and useful for environmental awareness and decision-support.
details:
ATHERIA — Earth Pulse

ATHERIA is an environmental intelligence platform designed to help users understand environmental conditions and emerging risks across different regions of Earth. Users can select a geographic location through an interactive globe and investigate environmental conditions using satellite-derived and Earth science datasets.

The current prototype integrates the NASA POWER API to retrieve temperature and precipitation data for selected locations. It analyzes the retrieved time series using statistical methods, including linear regression and the Mann–Kendall trend test, and presents the results through interactive visualizations and simplified reports.

ATHERIA focuses on five interconnected environmental threats: drought, wildfires, extreme heat, flooding, and marine pollution. Its broader vision is to combine relevant Earth-observation datasets with suitable forecasting products to identify emerging patterns and potential risks.

The project aims to make complex environmental information easier to understand, support environmental monitoring, and help decision-makers identify areas that may require attention. Its intended impact is to improve environmental awareness, preparedness, and evidence-based planning.

What makes ATHERIA creative is its integrated approach: instead of examining environmental threats in isolation, it aims to connect multiple environmental indicators within one location-based platform. It also presents scientific findings in a more accessible format, helping users understand not only what is happening but why it matters.

The platform was developed using Base44 for application development and the NASA POWER API for data retrieval, with AI-assisted development tools used during implementation. The prototype uses statistical analysis and data visualization rather than custom physical hardware. We made a custom hardware prototype just to show the impact of our project idea.

Throughout development, we considered data reliability, scientific accuracy, geographic coverage, data availability, observation delays, uncertainty, and accessibility. We also distinguish between currently integrated capabilities and planned features. ATHERIA is designed as a decision-support tool: it provides information and recommendations, while final decisions remain with people and relevant authorities.
